title: LAW OF MARINE INSURANCE I
modules: Institutional Framework For The Regulation Of Marine Insurance
mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned with risks management and risks financing."
The subject of insurance is concerned with risks management and risks financing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a voyage where the ship or goods on board/freight are exposed to maritime perils."
Marine adventure is a voyage where the ship or goods on board/freight are exposed to maritime perils.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used by merchants who ship on regular basis."
Floating and open cover policies are used by merchants who ship on regular basis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the apex regulatory body of insurance business in Nigeria."
The NAICOM is the apex regulatory body of insurance business in Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an item on the Exclusive Legislative List of the Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria 1999 as amended."
Insurance is an item on the Exclusive Legislative List of the Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria 1999 as amended.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an adjective, meaning 'of or pertaining to the sea'."
Marine is an adjective, meaning 'of or pertaining to the sea'.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a major player in global maritime industry."
The country is a major player in global maritime industry.
fib: ______ is a major employer of labour.
Marine insurance industry is a major employer of labour.
______ is a major boost to maritime activities through loss mitigation.
Marine insurance is a major boost to maritime activities through loss mitigation.
______ is composed of private companies grouped together in various underwriting syndicates.
The Lloyds of London is composed of private companies grouped together in various underwriting syndicates.
______ is a coastal country with large inland waterways to complement.
Nigeria is a coastal country with large inland waterways to complement.
______ means the assured must disclose all material circumstance within his knowledge which include those he knows and those he ought to know by the exercise of due diligence.
The duty to disclose means the assured must disclose all material circumstance within his knowledge which include those he knows and those he ought to know by the exercise of due diligence.
______ is a major employer of labour and contributor to the country's gross domestic product.
The nation's maritime sector is a major employer of labour and contributor to the country's gross domestic product.
